rationale: The stock gapped down ~11.6% on earnings and has bounced significantly off the session low ($185) to $204.43, now sitting at 84.5% of today's range with price near the 9-EMA ($204.65) and a wide 41.6 bps spread indicating thin liquidity. The bounce is largely exhausted with price stalling near the open ($208) acting as resistance, while the negative news sentiment and unfavorable estimate revision trends argue against a sustained long; however, the strong recovery from lows and elevated relative volume (4.75x) make a short equally risky. The risk/reward in either direction is unclear at this mid-range, high-spread juncture.
